acls.description: Access Control List definitions. Each entry defines a named ACL with type and value.

http_access_rules.description: Order matters. First matching rule wins. Use 'deny' before 'allow' to implement defaults.

acls.description: List of ACL names to match

http_port.description: List of ports on which Squid listens for HTTP requests (e.g., ['3128', '8080']).

transparent.description: Enable transparent proxy mode (requires iptables NAT redirection).

transparent_port.description: Port for transparent mode (must match one in http_port if enabled). Only used when transparent=true.

cache_dirs.description: Disk cache directories for persistent caching. UFS format only.

max_size.description: Maximum object size in kilobytes allowed in this directory

memory_cache_size.description: Size of RAM cache in megabytes. Keep ≤50% of system RAM for safety.

max_in_mem_cache_size.description: Maximum size (MB) of objects kept in memory cache. Set to null to omit.

log_rotate_count.description: Number of rotated log files to keep.

access_log.description: Path to access log file. Use 'none' to disable.

dns_nameservers.description: DNS servers to use (e.g., public resolvers: ['8.8.8.8', '8.8.4.4']).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support (required for dual-stack networks).

worker_processes.description: Number of Squid worker processes. Increase on multi-core systems (requires SMP support).

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for connecting to origin servers.

request_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for receiving client request headers.

read_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for reading responses from origin servers.

minimum_object_size.description: Minimum object size (KB) to cache (e.g., 0 for all, or 512 to skip tiny objects).

maximum_object_size.description: Maximum object size (MB) to cache (4GB default; adjust for large file caching needs).

authentication_enabled.description: Enable basic authentication (e.g., with NCSA or LDAP helpers).

auth_param_program.description: Path to authentication helper program and arguments.

refresh_patterns.description: Refresh patterns to determine cache freshness for matched URLs. First match wins.

visible_hostname.description: Hostname used in error pages and ICP queries (must be resolvable or match system hostname).

memory_cache_description.default: RAM used for caching active (recent) objects. Not part of disk cache.
memory_cache_description.description: Internal description — shown only in schema docs.

dns_description.default: DNS servers used for name resolution.
dns_description.description: Internal description — shown only in schema docs.

timeout_description.default: Network timeouts to avoid hung connections.
timeout_description.description: Internal description — shown only in schema docs.

visible_hostname_description.default: Server identity for error messages and inter-proxy comms.
visible_hostname_description.description: Internal description — shown only in schema docs.

worker_processes_description.default: Number of parallel worker processes to use (SMP support required).
worker_processes_description.description: Internal description — shown only in schema docs.
